chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the eggs of water birds, and he said:
"Whatever among them is like the eggs of chickens — meaning in its form — then eat it."

key_terms.بَيْضِ الدَّجَاجِ: the eggs of chickens, used here as the standard of comparison

ai.seo_question: Which eggs of water birds are halal to eat according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the eggs of water birds. The Imam عليه السلام states that eggs resembling chicken eggs in their natural form are permissible to eat, indicating a criterion for determining halal status.
